description: This file defines the Expanded formatter class for the SCSSPHP compiler, which formats SCSS output in an expanded, human-readable style. It extends the base Formatter class and overrides methods for indentation and block line formatting.

classes.name: Expanded
classes.description: A formatter class for outputting SCSS in an expanded, readable style, handling indentation and formatting of CSS blocks.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the formatter with specific indentation and formatting settings.

methods.name: indentStr
methods.description: Returns the current indentation string based on the indentation level.

methods.name: blockLines
methods.description: Formats the lines within a block, adding indentation and handling line breaks.
